title: apigw-access-log-jsonl/1 — one line
description: One JSON object per line of an API Gateway access log extract. Field names match the access-log variables a customer configures; extra fields are ignored and never stored (ADR-010 §3).

integrationStatus.description: $context.integrationStatus. A 5xx here means Lambda, not API Gateway, failed (Q-37).

errorResponseType.description: $context.error.responseType (a GatewayResponse type). Required to count any request as an Error (Q-37).
